name: tabs
title: Tabs / TabList / Tab / TabPanel
description: Tab panel switcher with controllable active tab (`TabList`, `Tab`, `TabPanel`).
author: wmzy <https://github.com/wmzy>
docs: haze-ui ships JS and CSS separately — this wrapper already imports 'haze-ui/css/tokens.css' and 'haze-ui/css/tabs.css', so no extra stylesheet setup is needed. Activate the design tokens by applying the 'lightTheme' (or 'darkTheme') + 'spacing' + 'typography' classes from 'haze-ui' to a root element. Details: https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
